steps.name: verify-first-pass-libgcc
argv: set -eu; archive=/toolchain/usr/lib/gcc/{target}/{version}/libgcc.a; test -f "$archive"; /usr/bin/nm --defined-only "$archive" > /work/libgcc-before.symbols; for symbol in _Unwind_Resume _Unwind_RaiseException _Unwind_DeleteException; do grep -E " [TW] $symbol$" /work/libgcc-before.symbols >/dev/null || exit 1; done; sha256sum "$archive" > /work/libgcc-before.sha256

steps.name: verify-first-pass-libgcc-unchanged
argv: set -eu; archive=/toolchain/usr/lib/gcc/{target}/{version}/libgcc.a; test -f "$archive"; sha256sum -c /work/libgcc-before.sha256; /usr/bin/nm --defined-only "$archive" > /work/libgcc-after.symbols; for symbol in _Unwind_Resume _Unwind_RaiseException _Unwind_DeleteException; do grep -E " [TW] $symbol$" /work/libgcc-after.symbols >/dev/null || exit 1; done
